# YEKTA (Hossein Yektapour)

> YEKTA is the artist name of Hossein Yektapour, a digital painter and former art director who spent fifteen years making images for advertising before turning to his own work. He makes conceptual digital paintings and interactive works, many of them tied together by a recurring red thread. His paintings are collected as NFTs on objkt and networked.art. Selected works include Vertigo, Undestined, The Witness, Inner Peace and Yekta.

Website: https://yektapour.com/
Process name: overthink(paint)ing

## About
- [About YEKTA](https://yektapour.com/about/): who YEKTA is and how he works

## Works
- [Futility](https://yektapour.com/work/futility/): Digital painting, 2026. A man kneels in a bare room, his hand on a small block, facing a wall with a narrow triangular hole at its foot. A thin red cord runs across the floor toward it. As an interactive piece, every touch makes him push: five blows bring the wall down, and behind it stands the same wall.
- [S-KNOT](https://yektapour.com/work/s-knot/): Digital painting, 2026. A head that has tied itself into a knot of its own flesh, held by loose red threads. Somewhere inside, one eye is still looking out.
- [Undestined](https://yektapour.com/work/undestined/): Digital painting, 2026. Stone heads balanced one on another, bound by a single red thread. Beside them a spinning top keeps turning, the only thing here still free to move.
- [Vertigo](https://yektapour.com/work/vertigo/): Digital painting, 2026. A wounded back, and behind it a crowd scratched into the wall like a memory that refuses to stay drawn. The dizziness of carrying everyone you have been.
- [The Witness](https://yektapour.com/work/the-witness/): Digital painting, 2026. Faces dissolve into a storm of brushwork while handwritten confessions surface and sink. The one who saw and the one who did turn out to share a face.
- [Kiss of Death](https://yektapour.com/work/kiss-of-death/): Digital painting, 2023. A cloud of skulls hangs above a body laid open on a ledge, vines growing out of it. Something above feeds on what lies below.
- [The Weight of Night](https://yektapour.com/work/the-weight-of-night/): Digital painting, 2025. An empty chair, a pair of shoes, and a body that exists only as trembling outlines of red, yellow and blue. The night presses down from the ceiling.
- [Corrupted Evolution](https://yektapour.com/work/corrupted-evolution/): Digital painting, 2025. A procession of hooded figures, bent a little lower with every step until they crawl. Evolution, walking in reverse.
- [Aperture](https://yektapour.com/work/aperture/): Digital painting, 2025. A ring of countless bodies spiraling around a single wound of light. The opening everyone is pushed toward, and no one chooses.
- [Snarth](https://yektapour.com/work/snarth/): Digital painting, 2025. A colossal sleeping face under a lid of clouds, its features climbed by tiny people and crossed by red threads. A mind as landscape.
- [Yekta](https://yektapour.com/work/yekta/): Digital painting, 2025. A horned self-portrait behind strings, a hand pulling the thread that moves its own face. Player and instrument at once.
- [Game](https://yektapour.com/work/game/): Digital painting, 2025. A seated figure with horns, a pencil in hand, unsure whether he is writing the rules or being written by them.
- [Doors](https://yektapour.com/work/doors/): Digital painting, 2024. A man sits among old leaning doors, a red thread running from his lips across the floor toward a pair of scissors he has not picked up.
- [OCD](https://yektapour.com/work/ocd/): Digital painting, 2024. A room half under water, paper boats on the surface and a whole life sunk below. Everything in order, everything drowning.
- [Dilemma](https://yektapour.com/work/dilemma/): Digital painting, 2024. A figure full of holes climbs a stair while its missing pieces drift behind on red threads. Each step leaves more of him below.
- [Inner Peace](https://yektapour.com/work/inner-peace/): Digital painting, 2024. Two dancers wound into one body by a red thread, held inside a circle of torn color. Balance that only exists while they keep moving.
- [Fall](https://yektapour.com/work/fall/): Digital painting, 2024. Four figures stacked on one another, tied by a red thread above an open floor. If one slips, all of them go.
- [Criminal](https://yektapour.com/work/criminal/): Digital painting, 2024. Seen from above: a body, a chalk outline that does not quite fit, scattered books and an overturned chair. The scene asks who drew the line.
- [Hero](https://yektapour.com/work/hero/): Digital painting, 2023. A thin man on a wooden chair faces a window bricked shut. Boxing gloves hang on the wall; a saw waits on the floor.
- [Goodbye](https://yektapour.com/work/goodbye/): Digital painting, 2023. A man hides his face beside a house of cards while someone climbs the stairs behind him, already half gone.
- [Inner Self](https://yektapour.com/work/inner-self/): Digital painting, 2023. Half of a body steps out of a cracked wall, pencil to its eye, drawing the face it is about to become.
- [Life Is A Game](https://yektapour.com/work/life-is-a-game/): Digital painting, 2023. A head turned into a chessboard while two hands play their moves on top of it. The eyes watch from the palms.
- [Shadow](https://yektapour.com/work/shadow/): Digital painting, 2023. A walking figure peeled back to the bone. Its shadow on the wall keeps the shape he used to have.
- [Solitary Reflection](https://yektapour.com/work/solitary-reflection/): Digital painting, 2023. A seated figure sinks into the wall, one hand melting over his face while other hands reach for him from the plaster.
- [The Last Dance](https://yektapour.com/work/the-last-dance/): Digital painting, 2023. A crucified body pulls free of the cross and dances on one foot toward the light, leaving the cloth behind.
- [Moment of Liberation](https://yektapour.com/work/moment-of-liberation/): Digital painting, 2023. A body of muscle and bone torn forward by its own speed, a bullet flying just ahead of it.
- [HUMAN NOT FOUND - 404](https://yektapour.com/work/human-not-found-404/): Digital painting, 2026. A man with a face that has become a hollow, wrapped in network cable, holding up his fingers as if to prove he is still there.
- [Selves](https://yektapour.com/work/selves/): Digital painting, 2023. A great hand rises from the dark; its fingers are people holding each other up, consoling, turning away.
- [Dependence](https://yektapour.com/work/dependence/): Digital painting, 2023. Two hollow figures grown into one another through roots and bone, a heart passed between them beneath a crescent moon.
- [P](https://yektapour.com/work/p/): 3D sculpture, 2022. A clay figure falls headfirst onto a pedestal, a small blue bird perched on its finger. The only calm thing in the fall.
- [Be](https://yektapour.com/work/be/): 3D sculpture, 2022. A clay figure crouches on a pedestal and offers a small blue bird to the air. Stillness held in one hand.

## Articles
- [Globus Sensation: A Painting That Screams When You Touch It](https://yektapour.com/articles/globus-sensation/): An interactive painting: touch the melting man, and a face bursts onto the wall in blood, screams from far away, and slowly fades.
- [Futility: A Painting That Pushes Back](https://yektapour.com/articles/futility/): An interactive painting: a man pushes a block against a wall, five blows bring it down, and behind it stands the same wall.
- [An Image, Listened To](https://yektapour.com/articles/an-image-listened-to/): An interactive work that takes any image and turns it into sound and film, by looking at it the way a person does.
- [Success Won't Fix It.](https://yektapour.com/articles/success-wont-fix-it/): What making art actually asks of you, and what it doesn't give back. An essay by YEKTA.
- [Attention Is the Medium.](https://yektapour.com/articles/attention-is-the-medium/): Before paint, before code, before anything. An essay by YEKTA on where attention goes, and where the work goes with it.
- [The Hours Nobody Applauds.](https://yektapour.com/articles/the-hours-nobody-applauds/): On dead time, slow growth, and the work behind the work. An essay by YEKTA.
- [Make What Only You Can See.](https://yektapour.com/articles/make-what-only-you-can-see/): Notes on creativity, timing and paying attention. An essay by YEKTA.
- [An Artist's Name Is Built Like a Painting: Layer by Layer.](https://yektapour.com/articles/a-name-is-built-layer-by-layer/): What 15 years of building brands taught me about building my own. An essay by YEKTA.
- [A Single Frame in a Movie That Never Ends.](https://yektapour.com/articles/a-single-frame/): On being tiny, and why that sets you free. An essay by YEKTA.
- [Discipline Was Never About Force.](https://yektapour.com/articles/discipline-was-never-about-force/): It's about what your brain expects. Why willpower fails, and five ways to retrain how effort feels. An essay by YEKTA.
- [Something Is Coming. Meanwhile, I'm Still Here.](https://yektapour.com/articles/something-is-coming/): On living with an uncertain future, the arrival that never arrives, and building a small version of the world you want, right now. An essay by YEKTA.
- [Slop Isn't a Style. It's an Intention.](https://yektapour.com/articles/slop-isnt-a-style/): Notes from an art director who vibe codes his art: what slop really is, what it isn't, and how he uses AI without letting it make the decisions.
- [Not Everyone Will Like Your Work. That's Where Freedom Starts.](https://yektapour.com/articles/not-everyone-will-like-your-work/): Being willing to be disliked doesn't mean caring less about people. It means caring about people without being controlled by them. An essay by YEKTA.
- [I Have Too Many Interests. It Took Me 15 Years to See It Was the Point.](https://yektapour.com/articles/too-many-interests/): Having many interests doesn't mean you're lost. It means you have many doors. An essay by YEKTA.
